summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors approved capital contributions of up to R$600M to I-Systems Soluções de Infraestrutura S.A. and R$70M to V8 Consulting S.A., both wholly owned subsidiaries. The funds come from the company's own cash and will be used for early repayment of the subsidiaries' financial obligations, optimizing the group's capital structure. No issuance of TIM shares occurs, and the company's share capital or ownership remains unchanged. This is an internal capital restructuring, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private transaction. The filing does not indicate a change in control, a strategic review, or any external event. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation event. No risk-arb angle exists.
